hypothesis: Direct complete-star supervision to goals near solved can improve the retained restoration Q on nearby non-restoration targets.

data.source_evaluation: paired FLAN original and small_ood cube2 cohorts

initialization: Continue the selected symmetric Q with its saved Adam moments and a lower learning rate. New sampling stream and supervision phase; not an exact resumption of the historical run.
supervision: Uniform physical parents, depth-balanced absolute near-solved goals, and separate solved-goal replay. Reuse fixed_batch, Huber and the existing complete-candidate soft rank. No new head, changed norm, search or waypoint selection at inference.
split: Protect the historical fixed-goal heldout state mask closed under axis symmetry. Exclude original FLAN regression, fresh validation and fresh test parent/candidate-to-goal relations, in both directions and all six axis presentations. Evaluation may contain pretraining exposures, so report continuation transfer rather than globally unseen relations.
selection: Fixed 5000 updates, primary final checkpoint; validation every 1000, fresh test and original small OOD only before and after training. No automatic extension or adoption. Preserve the original selected Q and all FLAN evaluation maps.
